root_cause.text: The dmirror_fops_release() function freed the dmirror structure without first migrating device private pages back to system memory, leaving a dangling pointer that is later dereferenced in the fault handler.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "When dmirror_fops_release() is called it frees the dmirror struct but doesn't migrate device private pages back to system memory first. This leaves those pages with a dangling zone_device_data pointer to the freed dmirror. If a subsequent fault occurs on those pages (eg. during coredump) the dmirror_devmem_fault() callback dereferences the stale pointer causing a kernel panic." The patch adds a loop in dmirror_fops_release() to call dmirror_device_evict_chunk() for each chunk before kfree(dmirror).

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing cleanup of device memory chunks during file release to prevent resource leaks by migrating pages back to system memory.
intent_record.what: Added a new function dmirror_device_evict_chunk that migrates pages from a device memory chunk to normal memory, and modified dmirror_fops_release to call this function for each device memory chunk before destroying the page table.
intent_record.how: On file close, the driver now iterates over device memory chunks and evicts them by migrating device pages back to system memory using migrate_device_range, migrate_device_pages, and migrate_device_finalize, ensuring no device memory pages remain after release.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove the unused or superseded dmirror_device_evict_chunk function as part of a code cleanup or restructuring of the device memory eviction path.
intent_record.what: Removed the entire definition of the static function `dmirror_device_evict_chunk`, which was approximately 60 lines long and implemented memory migration for evicting device private pages from a chunk.
intent_record.how: The function is no longer present in the codebase, so any previous callers will fail to compile unless they were also removed or replaced. This deletion eliminates the eviction logic for device chunks, impacting the ability to migrate and free device private pages from a chunk.

The group removes an unused function and does not address the missing migration of device private pages before freeing the dmirror structure, which is the core vulnerability.
